title: These Were the Hottest Stories on Wall Street Tuesday
text:
U.S. markets had a tough go Tuesday, posting the worst losses of the young year.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average dropped 363 points to 26,076 while the Nasdaq fell 64 points to 7,402 and the S&P 500 declined 31 points to 2,822.
Here are the stories that investors were reading Tuesday.
Here's the Worst Case Bitcoin Scenario Bitcoin has had a major run over the past 12 months, but here are five worst-case scenarios that could cause it to crash.
GE and Procter & Gamble Are No Go's Here's why investors should avoid General Electric ( GE ) and Procter & Gamble ( PG ) like the plague.
Apple Is Flashing Buy Signals Apple's ( AAPL ) stock is closing in on a 10% correction, making it an attractive buy , according to Bret Kenwell.
